name: Elite Youth
overview: Since its inception in 2010, the Nike Elite Youth Basketball League (EYBL) has redefined grassroots basketball, with more than 125 alumni on NBA rosters to start the 2018-19 season. Told directly by past, present, and future NBA stars themselves, ELITE YOUTH follows these promising athletes through the 2019 EYBL circuit, revealing the trials and tribulations of high school life, high stakes college recruitment, and basketball stardom - all before the age of eighteen
